title: Review of c42's predator lifespan trade-off: replicated on seed 7; longer-lived predators reach persistent splits at K=20 only when the prey stop dividing or go extinct
summary: Claim world unchanged, seed 7, 128^2, t=12000, labkit default K=20. Claim defaults: predator persistent splits 0 (74 raw splits), prey 0 persistent splits, 7 prey and 21 predators at the end. kq 0.0025: predators 7 persistent splits (generation 1, 6 persistent tracks), prey 4 at the end with 0 persistent splits. Ksat 0.5, k2 0.5: predators 12 persistent splits (generation 3, 41 persistent tracks, 55 at the end), prey extinct (0 at the end). Same pattern as the finding's seed 0 (kq 0.0025: 8 (gen 2), prey 1; Ksat 0.5: 15 (gen 3), prey 0).
